name: What is the difference between a custom kitchen remodel and a standard kitchen update?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom kitchen remodel and a standard kitchen update?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen update typically involves cosmetic changes like painting, refacing cabinets, or replacing appliances without altering the layout or structural elements. A custom kitchen remodel, however, often entails a complete overhaul, including changing the kitchen's footprint, relocating plumbing and electrical, custom-built cabinetry, and high-end finishes tailored specifically to your preferences and space. It offers greater design flexibility and personalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard update is cosmetic (paint, refacing), while a custom remodel involves significant layout changes, custom elements, and structural work, offering greater personalization.
